notes: 65 native observations; 58 accepted full-LCD/status key replays. Four fraction-navigation frames and three special MathI cursor frames retained referenceOnly. Saved directly to project.

LineI overwrite cursor is an underline: ten pixels wide, three high, with one-pixel inset. Normal insertion has the ordinary vertical caret. Replacing a digit, forward deletion under overwrite, deletion at the line end, and deletion at the beginning of the root line were measured.

LineI TOOLS omits Undo. The first two originally intended undo requests actually toggle Verify ON and open its single-row tools menu; frames were renamed to the observed actions. Undo/redo is tested separately in MathI. Complex LineI uses the same absence rule, but no new Complex frames are claimed here.

MathI undo/redo toggles the last edit and restores the cursor. AC can be undone. DEL after a scalar result is ignored in MathI and LineI. DEL at root start removes the token on the right; whole function-open prefixes are removed atomically.

Deleting the root symbol before sqrt(9) preserves 9. Direct fraction denominator deletion, undo/redo, unwrapping the empty denominator and undo were measured; the unwrapped numerator has the caret after it. A separate repeated-arrow fraction-navigation path remains deferred.

Changing input/output resets overwrite to insertion. MathI insertion stays insertion after SHIFT DEL; its special temporary insertion-cursor shape is deferred, while insertion of 9 before 2 gives 1+92 as observed.
